
```{r}
#| label: noise-over-session
#| fig-height: 6
if (nrow(kept) == 0) {
  cat("\n\nNo surviving trials to plot.\n\n")
} else {
  n_sub <- n_distinct(kept$dataset)
  cohort_median <- median(kept$baseline_sd_uv, na.rm = TRUE)
  op <- ggplot(kept, aes(x = trial, y = baseline_sd_uv)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5, colour = alz_blue) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = cohort_median, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = alz_red, linewidth = 0.7, formula = y ~ x) +
    facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(4, n_sub)) +
    labs(x = "Trial number", y = "Pre-stimulus SD (uV)",
         subtitle = "Free y-axis per subject. Dashed line: median across all subjects (same value in every panel)") +
    alz_theme() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey30"))
  print(op)
}
```
